es.quote: Destaco la solidez técnica de Christian en React y TypeScript, su disciplina en la escritura de código limpio y su capacidad para diseñar interfaces adaptativas con gran fidelidad. Sobresale por su trabajo colaborativo, resolución proactiva de incidencias y cumplimiento con los plazos. Será una excelente incorporación para cualquier equipo que busque un desarrollador frontend de alto nivel.
es.author: Yendri

en.quote: I want to highlight Christian's technical strength in React and TypeScript, his discipline when writing clean code and his ability to design adaptive interfaces with great fidelity. He stands out for his collaborative work, his proactive resolution of issues and his compliance with deadlines. He will be an excellent addition to any team looking for a high-level frontend developer.
en.author: Yendri
